# Komoka Heating & Cooling

> Komoka Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Komoka, Middlesex County, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Phone: (519) 657-0133  |  Email: contact@komokaheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://komokaheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Komoka, Kilworth, Ilderton, London, Mount Brydges, Delaware
